<style>
:root{--bg:#060611;--surf:#0b0f2a;--ink:#eaf3ff;--mute:#93a8cf;--line:#1d2a5c;--acc:#40c0e0;--acc2:#ff5fd2;--gold:#4ade80;color-scheme:dark;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
:root[data-theme="light"]{--bg:#eef4ff;--surf:#fff;--ink:#0b1230;--mute:#4a5b82;--line:#d3def5;--acc:#1d6fd1;--acc2:#c026a8;--gold:#15803d;color-scheme:light}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);scroll-behavior:smooth}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:400 16px/1.6 "Plus Jakarta Sans",system-ui,sans-serif}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);background:var(--bg);z-index:10}
.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
nav{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:9;background:var(--bg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
nav .wrap{display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:center;height:56px}
nav b{font:700 16px "Plus Jakarta Sans",system-ui,sans-serif;margin-right:auto;display:flex;align-items:center}.dk{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center;border:2px solid #40c0e0;box-shadow:0 0 14px -2px rgba(64,192,224,.6);margin-right:10px;flex:none}
nav a{color:var(--mute);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500;font-size:14px}nav a:hover{color:var(--acc)}
#th{background:none;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink);border-radius:99px;width:34px;height:34px;cursor:pointer;font-size:15px}
.hero{padding:72px 0 48px}
.hero p.k{color:var(--gold);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:13px;margin:0}
h1{font:700 clamp(40px,8vw,84px)/1 Cinzel,Georgia,serif;margin:12px 0 20px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
h1 em{font-style:normal;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#93c5ea,#40c0e0,#ff5fd2);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.hero p.l{max-width:620px;font-size:19px;color:var(--mute);margin:0 0 28px}
.btn{display:inline-block;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:99px;border:1.5px solid var(--ink);color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;margin:0 8px 8px 0}
.btn:hover{background:var(--acc);border-color:var(--acc);color:#0b0714}.btn.p{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#2080e0,#c026d3);border-color:transparent;color:#fff}.btn.p:hover{filter:brightness(1.15);color:#fff}
.stats{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:28px;margin-top:36px;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.stats div{font-size:13px;color:var(--mute)}.stats strong{display:block;font:700 30px Cinzel,Georgia,serif;color:var(--ink)}
h2.phase{font:700 26px Cinzel,Georgia,serif;margin:56px 0 4px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
h2.phase::after{content:"";flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--line)}
.proj{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr 1fr;gap:28px;padding:22px;margin:20px 0;background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;align-items:start}
.shots{display:grid;gap:8px}.shots img{width:100%;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);display:block;background:var(--surf)}
.shots.n2,.shots.n3{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.shots.n3 img:first-child{grid-column:1/3}
.proj:nth-of-type(even) .shots{order:2}.shots.cc{align-items:center}.shots.cc img+img{max-height:300px;width:auto;justify-self:center}.ost{font-size:14px;color:var(--mute);margin:8px 0 0}.ost a{color:var(--acc);font-weight:700}.me{display:block;width:100%;max-width:260px;aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:cover;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:20px}
.meta{color:var(--gold);font-weight:700;font-size:11px;margin:0;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase}
h3{font:700 30px/1.1 Cinzel,Georgia,serif;margin:6px 0}
.role{font-weight:700;margin:0 0 10px;color:var(--acc2)}.role.todo{color:var(--mute);font-style:italic;font-weight:500}
.tags{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;padding:0;margin:14px 0}
.tags li{background:rgba(64,192,224,.12);border:1px solid rgba(64,192,224,.3);border-radius:99px;padding:2px 11px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--acc)}
#about{padding:56px 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:32px}
#about h2{font:700 30px Cinzel,Georgia,serif;margin:0}#about p{margin:0 0 14px}.sk{padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--mute)}
#contact{padding:48px 0 64px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
footer{color:var(--mute);font-size:13px;padding-bottom:32px}
@media(max-width:760px){.proj,#about{grid-template-columns:1fr}.proj:nth-of-type(even) .shots{order:0}nav a.h{display:none}.hero{padding-top:44px}}
.vw{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(10,9,8,.94);display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 12px) 12px calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 12px)}.vw.on{display:flex}.vb{display:flex;width:100%;max-width:1100px;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:#f3ede0;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:8px}.vb b{margin-right:auto;font-family:Cinzel,Georgia,serif;font-size:17px}.vb button{background:none;border:1px solid #5b5448;color:#f3ede0;border-radius:99px;padding:6px 14px;cursor:pointer;font:inherit}.vb button:hover{border-color:#40c0e0;color:#40c0e0}.vs{flex:1;min-height:0;width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.vs img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain;border-radius:6px;background:#fff}body{background-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 40% at 50% 0,rgba(32,64,192,.32),transparent);background-repeat:no-repeat}.me{box-shadow:0 0 35px -5px rgba(32,128,224,.4);border-color:rgba(64,192,224,.45)}.proj .shots img{border-color:rgba(64,192,224,.25)}.pics{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-top:20px}.pics .me{margin-top:0;flex:1;min-width:0;max-width:none}</style></head><body>
<nav><div class="wrap"><b><img class="dk" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Dylan Kho">Dylan Kho</b><a class="h" href="#work">Work</a><a class="h" href="#about">About</a><a href="#contact">Contact</a><button id="th" aria-label="Toggle theme">◐</button></div></nav>
<header class="wrap hero">
<p class="k">Interactive Media &amp; Game Development · SIT–DigiPen</p>
<h1>I build games that <em>play well</em> and sound good.</h1>
<p class="l">Gameplay programmer, designer and music composer. Over four years I have shipped board games, mixed-reality, AR and PC projects.</p>
<a class="btn p" href="#work">See my work</a><a class="btn" href="#contact">Get in touch</a>
<div class="stats"><div><strong>9</strong>projects + 1 internship</div><div><strong>4</strong>platforms: PC, HoloLens, mobile AR, tabletop</div><div><strong>2</strong>schools: NP &amp; SIT–DigiPen</div></div>
</header>
<main class="wrap" id="work"><h2 class="phase">SIT–DigiPen</h2><article class="proj" id="p8"><div class="shots n3"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Fool’s Gambit title screen" loading="lazy"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Fool’s Gambit gameplay: the Empress fighting the Magician" loading="lazy"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Fool’s Gambit character select" loading="lazy"></div><div class="info"><p class="meta">Year 2 · Trimesters 1 & 2 · Tarot-themed 2D fighting game</p><h3>Fool’s Gambit</h3><p class="role">Programmer · Audio, bug testing, UI/UX</p><p>Choose the Magician or the Priestess and fight to conquer fate, with training mode and controller support. Our Year 2 Game Project is a fighter with three characters (the Magician, the Priestess and the Empress), each with a different move set. The Fate bar is the ultimate meter and fills as you deal and take damage. Training Mode is free practice with unlimited HP and Fate, so you can test combos on a static dummy or an AI enemy. A team built the custom C++ engine, move sets, enemy AI and assets from scratch in six months. I handled audio, bug testing and UI/UX.</p><ul class="tags"><li>C++</li><li>Fighting game</li><li>Controller support</li><li>Windows</li></ul><div class="links"><a class="btn" href="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1pMqsqWo84EdLrOUCkT9MQxMBg-bdl2DH/view?usp=drive_link" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Download for Windows ↗</a></div></div></article><article class="proj" id="p7"><div class="shots n1"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Climb screenshot 1" loading="lazy"></div><div class="info"><p class="meta">Year 1 · Trimester 2 · Infinite stair climber</p><h3>Climb</h3><p class="role">Gameplay programmer</p><p>An infinite stair climber built around moment-to-moment gameplay: climb ever higher, dodge spikes and shaking steps, punch through stone obstacles and collect gekos for score and currency. I built the power-ups and their indicators, the stone obstacles and the punching mechanic. Team of four.</p><ul class="tags"><li>C++</li><li>Arcade</li></ul><div class="links"></div></div></article><h2 class="phase">Ngee Ann Polytechnic</h2><article class="proj" id="internship"><div class="shots"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Internship at Team Elevate poster" loading="lazy"></div><div class="info"><p class="meta">Year 3 · Sem 2 · 6-month internship</p><h3>Team Elevate</h3><p class="role">Game developer &amp; facilitator intern</p><p>Team Elevate runs virtual and physical team-building events built around games. I spent most of the internship in Unity, remaking The Amazing Race, The Gameshow Experience, Tomb Raider King and The Great Zodiac Hunt with new designs and facilitator tools. I also built custom races for Procter &amp; Gamble and Workforce Singapore (point system, videos and learning points), created an original game, The Grand Christmas Delivery, facilitated Zoom sessions, and helped run laser tag events.</p><p>Key takeaways: designing for a general audience, working to client briefs and keeping sessions running smoothly for live players.</p><ul class="tags"><li>Unity</li><li>Client work</li><li>Game remakes</li><li>Facilitation</li></ul></div></article><article class="proj" id="p6"><div class="shots n3"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Heart of the Forest title art featuring Bud" loading="lazy"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Heart of the Forest gameplay in the forest" loading="lazy"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Heart of the Forest boss fight" loading="lazy"></div><div class="info"><p class="meta">Year 3 · Sem 1 · Top-down rogue-lite dungeon crawler</p><h3>Heart of the Forest</h3><p class="role">Programmer · Music &amp; sound design</p><p>Play as Bud, a farmer fighting the pollution at the heart of the forest. Mix three classes into six builds, use six status ailments, and grow a farm to craft and level up between runs. Rooms are generated by wandering “crawlers” and every run is different. Unity, PC with controller support.</p><ul class="tags"><li>Unity</li><li>Procedural generation</li><li>Rogue-lite</li><li>Hand-drawn</li></ul><div class="links"><button class="btn p" data-deck="hotf">View presentation (93 slides)</button><a class="btn" href="https://youtu.be/A1G3MzkUjfA?si=zt2ZrMXx72-JBxir" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Watch trailer ↗</a><a class="btn" href="https://swarsch.itch.io/heart-of-the-forest" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Download on itch.io ↗</a></div><p class="ost">Soundtrack, composed by me: <a href="https://youtu.be/zoms5jWArA4" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Main theme</a> · <a href="https://youtu.be/cYVh3QdROmU" target="_blank" rel="noopener">The Farm</a> · <a href="https://youtu.be/Gjh6AvcMTYY" target="_blank" rel="noopener">The Forest</a> · <a href="https://youtu.be/0b2nGjEV_ko" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Boss theme (Captain Dodo)</a></p></div></article><article class="proj" id="p5"><div class="shots n2"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Spellslinger title screen" loading="lazy"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Spellslinger gameplay: HP, element and progress bars" loading="lazy"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Spellslinger gameplay: the wizard in a cave" loading="lazy"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Spellslinger environment design" loading="lazy"></div><div class="info"><p class="meta">Year 2 · Sem 2 · One-button mobile game</p><h3>Spellslinger</h3><p class="role">Solo programmer</p><p>A one-button elemental game: tap once to fire a projectile of your current element, double-tap to swap elements, and hit each obstacle with its matching element to clear it. Get stuck on an obstacle and you lose HP, and stay stuck too long and you die. The story asks you to light the braziers and stop the Dark. I was the sole programmer.</p><ul class="tags"><li>Unity</li><li>One-button</li><li>Mobile</li><li>Fantasy</li></ul><div class="links"><a class="btn" href="https://mono-khrome.itch.io/spellslinger" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Download &amp; trailer on itch.io ↗</a></div></div></article><article class="proj" id="p4"><div class="shots n2 cc"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Covid Companion logo" loading="lazy"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Covid Companion gameplay screenshot" loading="lazy"></div><div class="info"><p class="meta">Year 2 · Sem 2 · Augmented-reality app</p><h3>Covid Companion</h3><p class="role">Solo programmer</p><p>An AR app that brings Covid-19 posters at MRT and bus stations to life as a game. Help Satomi fend off waves of the coronavirus while picking up tips on how to fight back yourself. Needs just one poster and one app, and scores can be shared with friends. I was the solo programmer.</p><ul class="tags"><li>AR</li><li>Unity</li><li>Vuforia</li><li>Mobile</li></ul><div class="links"><a class="btn" href="https://youtube.com/shorts/9O21BqXM2PU" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Watch showcase ↗</a></div></div></article><article class="proj" id="p3"><div class="shots n2"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Slimepede! screenshot 1" loading="lazy"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Slimepede! screenshot 2" loading="lazy"></div><div class="info"><p class="meta">Year 2 · Sem 2 · HoloLens mixed-reality tower defence</p><h3>Slimepede!</h3><p class="role">Programmer · Music composer</p><p>A single-player, tile-based tower defence built in Unity for the HoloLens. Spend Slime Jello on four towers to hold off three slime types across 20 waves, protecting the village of Cobbsrock. I programmed gameplay and composed the looping main theme.</p><ul class="tags"><li>Unity</li><li>HoloLens / MRTK</li><li>Tower defence</li><li>Music</li></ul><div class="links"><a class="btn" href="https://youtu.be/B1jJRk5OpVY" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Watch gameplay ↗</a></div></div></article><article class="proj" id="p2"><div class="shots n2"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Escape The Planet main menu" loading="lazy"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Escape The Planet gameplay: rope bridge over lava" loading="lazy"></div><div class="info"><p class="meta">Year 2 · Sem 2 · 3D parkour and puzzle game</p><h3>Escape The Planet</h3><p class="role">Solo developer · Unity</p><p>You are a military pilot investigating an unknown planet when a sudden gravity field drags your plane down, crashes it and flings you across the surface. Parkour through caves, lava and rope bridges, retrieve artifacts and solve riddles to get back to your plane and fly home to Earth. A health bar and a running death counter track your attempts. Designed and built solo in Unity.</p><ul class="tags"><li>Unity</li><li>3D</li><li>Parkour</li><li>Problem solving</li></ul><div class="links"><a class="btn" href="https://youtu.be/49RcgncO8EA" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Watch gameplay ↗</a></div></div></article><article class="proj" id="p1"><div class="shots n3"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Narathreoth box art" loading="lazy"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Narathreoth tiles and event cards" loading="lazy"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Narathreoth physical copy" loading="lazy"></div><div class="info"><p class="meta">Year 1 · Sem 2 · Cooperative RPG board game</p><h3>Narathreoth</h3><p class="role">Game Designer</p><p>A tile-laying pirate-fantasy board game for four. Build the map as you explore, defeat monsters, collect artifact pieces, then summon and slay an ancient sea beast. Comes with box art, 3D-printed tokens and a companion app for health, levelling and rolls.</p><ul class="tags"><li>Board game</li><li>Co-op</li><li>Tile placement</li></ul><div class="links"><button class="btn p" data-deck="nara">View presentation (35 slides)</button><a class="btn" href="https://youtu.be/Ft6RlE0vDWU" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Prototype &amp; gameplay ↗</a></div></div></article><article class="proj" id="p0"><div class="shots n1"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Galactic Getaway screenshot 1" loading="lazy"></div><div class="info"><p class="meta">Year 1 · Sem 2 · Tabletop card game</p><h3>Galactic Getaway</h3><p class="role">Game Designer</p><p>Four captains are trapped near a black hole and only enough fuel remains for one escape. Spend action points to attack, defend and refuel, counter rivals with shields and EMPs, or be the last ship standing. Includes a convention banner and an exclusive board.</p><ul class="tags"><li>Card game</li><li>Free-for-all</li></ul><div class="links"><button class="btn p" data-deck="gg">View presentation (20 slides)</button><a class="btn" href="https://youtu.be/ZDGJP0iNgPc" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Minecraft prototype &amp; gameplay ↗</a><a class="btn" href="https://app.roll20.net/campaigns/details/7413420/galactic-getaway" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Play on Roll20 ↗</a></div></div></article></main>
<section class="wrap" id="about"><div><h2>About</h2><div class="pics"><img class="me" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Portrait of Dylan Kho" loading="lazy"><img class="me" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Illustrated portrait of Dylan Kho" loading="lazy"></div></div><div><p>Hi, I’m Dylan. I started programming at 14 after a game design bootcamp, and I’ve been chasing that feeling ever since: the moment something you built finally works.</p><p>These days I’m at DigiPen @ SIT, writing C++ on a custom engine and building a web app that turns photos into 3D crime scenes for my final year project. Before that I did Immersive Media and Game Design at Ngee Ann Poly, where I picked up Unity and learned that every game is one bug away from being a different game.</p><p>I like small teams where I can jump between code, audio and design. I also have a music background, which lets me compose our games’ music in MuseScore so every track fits the mood of the game.</p><p class="sk"><strong>Skills:</strong> C++, Unity / C#, Python, JavaScript, music composition.</p></div></section>
<section class="wrap" id="contact"><h2 style="font:700 30px Cinzel,Georgia,serif;margin:0 0 12px">Let’s talk</h2><p>Open to internships and collaborations.</p>
